Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Vinod - 34 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Nitin - 29 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
3. Neeta - 31 years, daughter
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
4. Sonali - 56 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The potter's yard - a wheel, clay pots
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The potter's yard - Day

[Vinod stands in the yard. Sonali and Neeta stand near him.]

Vinod: "Let's do something fun today."

[Vinod shapes a clay pot on the potter's wheel.]

Sonali: "And then?"

[Vinod paints the clay lamps.]

Vinod: "How beautiful!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Nitin: "So, here we are!"

[Vinod is dying to see the new film.]

Vinod (excited): "Yes, of course."

[Vinod nearly dies laughing at the joke.]

Vinod (laughing): "And then?"

[Vinod plays dead to fool his sister.]

Nitin: "I knew it!"

[Vinod's phone dies in the middle of the call.]

Vinod: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
